basic_details.job_title: IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (Chemistry) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Chemistry, Indian Institute of Technology Indore, has invited applications for one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in an ANRF-funded project on machine learning-integrated scanning probe microscopy analysis for solid-state Li-ion battery interfaces. The fellowship is ₹37,000 per month plus HRA (as per norms) for a JRF with GATE/NET qualification, initially for one year and extendable up to three years. Candidates need a Master's Degree in Chemistry or a relevant field, or a four-year undergraduate programme in a related field, with first division, plus a valid GATE or UGC/C

age_limit.details: Maximum 32 years. The notice states that age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India norms for SC/ST/OBC/Women/PwD candidates. It prints no "as on" date for counting age. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility wording.

qualification.details: Master's Degree in Chemistry or other fields relevant to Chemical Sciences with first division (or as defined below) from a recognized institution. OR a four-year undergraduate programme (FYUP) in Chemical Sciences or a field related to Chemical Sciences, or in the relevant Department of Engineering/Technology, with first division (or as defined below) from a recognized institution.

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (JRF) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Machine Learning-Integrated Scanning Probe Microscopy Analysis for Solid-State Li Ion Battery Interface Performance Evaluation
Initially one year, extendable up to three years
Department of Chemistry, IIT Indore, Indore

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The post sits in the Department of Chemistry at IIT Indore, Khandwa Road, Simrol, Indore. The research project is funded by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF). The Principal Investigator is Dr. Pravarthana Dhanapal, Department of Chemistry, IIT Indore. The notice invites highly motivated and research-oriented candidates.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: A candidate must satisfy both criteria below, (i) and (ii). Master's Degree in Chemistry or other fields relevant to Chemical Sciences with first division (or as defined below) from a recognized institution. OR a four-year undergraduate programme (FYUP) in Chemical Sciences or a field related to Chemical Sciences, or in the relevant Department of Engineering/Technology, with first division (or as defined below) from a recognized institution. A valid and qualified GATE score with a good rank. OR a valid and qualified UGC/CSIR-NET Lectureship (LS). OR a valid qualifying score in UGC/CSIR-NET Category III (admission to Ph.D. only). The notice defines this as institutions or universities incorporated by an Act of Parliament or State Legislature in India; institutions declared "Deemed to be University" under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956; or institutions with an equivalent qualification recognized by the Ministry of Education, Government of India, AICTE, UGC or AIU, including reputed foreign universities. Interest or prior experience in solid-state Li-ion batteries, electrode-electrolyte interfaces, ceramic or halide solid electrolytes, electrochemical impedance spectroscopy, XRD/SEM/XPS, AFM/KPFM/conductive AFM and scanning-probe data analysis. Expertise in every listed area is not required. Maximum 32 years. The notice states that age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India norms for SC/ST/OBC/Women/PwD candidates. It prints no "as on" date for counting age. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility wording.

rows.minimum_marks_cpi: 60% aggregate OR first class as specified by the university OR CGPA/CPI 6.0/10 (or equivalent)
55% aggregate OR first class as specified by the university OR CGPA/CPI 5.5/10 (or equivalent)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship for a JRF with GATE/NET qualification is ₹37,000/- per month + HRA (as per norms). The appointment and fellowship are governed by the applicable ANRF and IIT Indore norms. The appointment is initially for one year and is extendable up to three years based on satisfactory performance. Any extension is subject to approval by the competent authority. The selected candidate will be strongly encouraged to apply for admission to the Ph.D. programme at IIT Indore, subject to the Institute's admission requirements and selection process. Any later Institute Teaching Assistantship (TA) support will be governed by the prevailing Institute rules and approvals. The notice lists Ph.D. admission categories at https://www.iiti.ac.in/admissions/phd_info/sciences/categories .

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Prepare a single PDF containing your CV, academic marksheets and degree certificates, the qualifying-examination scorecard/certificate, and a brief statement of research interests and relevant experience. Email the PDF to Dr. Pravarthana Dhanapal, Assistant Professor, Department of Chemistry, Indian Institute of Technology Indore, at [email protected] . Write the email subject exactly as: Application for JRF - ANRF. Send the application on or before 15 December 2026. CV Academic marksheets and degree certificates Qualifying-examination scorecard/certificate Brief statement of research interests and relevant experience

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted regarding the interview. The interview schedule will be communicated by email and will be conducted online. The appointment is subject to verification of eligibility and approval by the competent authority. The notice gives no interview date.
